Access.description:
An item's access level: its JSDoc's `@public`, `@protected`, `@package`, `@private` or
`@access` tag, or else `protected` for a TypeScript `protected` member and `public` for the rest.

oneOf.description: No access tag, or `@public`.
`@protected`, or a TypeScript `protected` member.
`@package`.
`@private`.

allowlist.description: Words that look like code and aren't, on top of the default ones.

globals.description: Globals: `window.a = …` and `globalThis.a = …` at the top level.

anyOf.description: Files, each winning over the ones before it.

Extends.description: A config file to extend, or a list of them.

FileDocs.description: Whether each file needs a JSDoc block of its own.

oneOf.description: Files aren't items.

Each file is an item of kind `module`, documented when its first JSDoc block has `@file`,
`@fileoverview`, `@overview`, `@module` or `@packageDocumentation`, with text. That block then
documents nothing else.

names.description: Regexes: an item whose name matches one doesn't count. A member matches by its own name or as `Class.member`.

Inherit.description: What documents an item by inheriting its docs.

oneOf.description: An `@inheritdoc` tag.
An `@inheritdoc` tag, or TypeScript's `override` on a class member.

Kind.description: What kind of declaration an item is.

oneOf.description: `function f() {}`, or a function assigned to an export.
`class C {}`, or a class assigned to an export.

A class method or an interface method signature, or a function member of a tagged object
literal, an object type or a CommonJS export (with `members` or `commonjsMembers`).
A getter (with its setter, if any), a lone setter, or an `accessor` property.

A class field or an interface property signature, or another member that isn't a function
(with `members` or `commonjsMembers`).
`const`, `let` or `var`, or another value CommonJS exports by name.
`interface I {}`.
`type T = …`.
`enum E {}`.
`namespace N {}`.
`export default` or `module.exports =` of an expression.
A file, with `fileDocs`.

Level.description: How much a check's findings matter.

oneOf.description: The check doesn't run.
Its findings are reported, and the scan still passes.
Its findings are reported, and fail the scan.
The public members of classes and interfaces.

Those, and enum members, the members of a type alias's object type, and the properties of
an object literal tagged `@enum`, `@namespace` or `@lends`. A matching `@property` in the
parent's block documents one of these.

NoOptions.description: The options of a check that has none.

Override.description: Settings for the files some globs match, in place of the top-level ones.

exclude.description: In place of the top-level `exclude`, for these files.

files.description: Gitignore-style globs of the files it's for, relative to this file's folder.

scope.description: In place of the top-level `scope`, for these files. `--scope` wins over it.

anyOf.description: A documented percentage from 0 to 100, or a negative whole number for at most that many undocumented items.

additionalProperties.description: For the files a gitignore-style glob matches, relative to this file's folder, together.

perFile.description: For each file on its own.

threshold.description: In place of the top-level `threshold`, for these files.

doc-markdown.description: A description's code is in backticks, and its lists have no lazy continuation lines.

empty-tag-description.description: Each @param, @returns, @throws and @yields tag has a description.

informative-docs.description: A description says more than its item's name.

param-names.description: Each @param names a parameter of its function or method.

require-param.description: Each parameter of a function or method has a matching @param.

require-returns.description: A function or method that returns a value has @returns, unless its return type is void.

require-template.description: Each type parameter of a declaration has a @template.

require-throws.description: An exported function or method that throws has @throws.

require-yields.description: A generator that yields a value has @yields.

summary-sentence.description: A description's first sentence is short and ends with a period.

valid-link.description: Each {@link} is well formed, and a target that's a name is declared or imported in its file.

oneOf.description: What a module exports, with the public members of exported classes and interfaces.
Every module-level declaration, exported or not.

What the package's entry points (package.json's `exports`, `main`, `module`, `types` and
`typings`) export, following re-exports through the module graph.

maxLength.description: The most characters the summary may have.

period.description: Whether the summary ends with `.`, `!` or `?`.

description: docov's settings. Flags on the command line win over them.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

access.description: Count only items with these access levels, by their access tags. Without it, access tags change nothing.

baseline.description: A file of undocumented items the gates let pass, relative to this file's folder, as `docov --write-baseline` writes it.

commonjsMembers.description: Count `X.prototype.m = …` and `X.m = …` at the top level as members of X, a function or class declared there, and `this.a = …` in a CommonJS file as an export.

completeThreshold.description: The lowest percentage of counted items documented with a @param for each parameter that passes.

examplesThreshold.description: The lowest percentage of counted items with an @example that passes.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style globs of files to leave out, relative to this file's folder, on top of .gitignore.

excludeTags.description: Leave out items whose JSDoc has one of these tags, named without the @ (`internal` for @internal).

exports.description: Which ways of exporting count under the `exports` scope. Globals are items under either scope only when on.

extends.description: Config files this one builds on, relative to its folder. Its keys win over theirs, and a later one's over an earlier one's.

fileDocs.description: Whether each file needs a JSDoc block of its own (`@file`, `@fileoverview`, `@overview`, `@module` or `@packageDocumentation`, with text), counted as an item of kind `module`.

ignoreDeprecated.description: Leave out items whose JSDoc has @deprecated.

inherit.description: What documents an item by inheriting its docs.

jsdocConfig.description: A jsdoc.json, relative to this file's folder, whose `source` picks the files: its `include` is the paths unless `paths` is set, and its `exclude`, `includePattern` and `excludePattern` leave files out.

kinds.description: Count only these kinds of item. Every kind counts without it.

maxUndocumented.description: The most undocumented items that pass.

members.description: Which members count: those of classes and interfaces, or all of them, with enum members, a type alias's object members and the properties of an object literal tagged @enum, @namespace or @lends.

nested.description: Scan each file with the nearest docov.json, docov.jsonc or .docovrc above it, up to this file's folder, merged over this one. Only the root config's counts.

overrides.description: Settings for the files globs match, in place of the top-level ones. For each file and setting, the last override that matches it and has the setting wins.

paths.description: Files and folders to scan, relative to this file's folder. Defaults to the folder docov runs in.

releaseTagsThreshold.description: The lowest percentage of top-level exports with exactly one of @public, @beta, @alpha and @internal that passes.

reportUnusedIgnores.description: Fail on a docov-ignore-next-line whose items are documented anyway.

requireDescription.description: Count a JSDoc block only with text before its first tag, or @description, @summary, @classdesc or @inheritdoc.

rules.description: Doc checks to turn on, by rule id: "off", "warn" or "error", or that level with the check's options, as ["warn", { … }]. Every check is off by default.

skipGenerated.description: Leave out files whose first comment has @generated.

anyOf.description: A documented percentage from 0 to 100, or a negative whole number for at most that many undocumented items.

additionalProperties.description: For the files a gitignore-style glob matches, relative to this file's folder, together.

perFile.description: For each file on its own.

threshold.description: The lowest documented percentage that passes, or thresholds by path: `global` for every file together, `perFile` for each file, and gitignore-style globs for the files each matches together.

typesThreshold.description: The lowest percentage of JavaScript functions and methods with a {type} on each @param and @returns that passes.

virtual.description: Count a JavaScript file's named @typedef and @callback blocks as items of kind `type`, documented when they have a description. They then document nothing else.
